system.description:
A creature marked as a Refraction Point has been saturated with Storm Release chakra, and their body acts as a Prism for the Laser Circus technique.

When a creature marked as a Refraction Point takes damage from a ranged attack as a result of a Ranton Hijutsu or a Laser Circus attack, the attack is refracted. The nearest creature within 30 feet of the Refraction Point, that is hostile to the Ranton that inflicted this condition becomes a target, immediately taking half the damage the Refraction Point took. This condition then immediately ends.

If a creature marked as a Refraction Point takes damage as a result of another creature that is marked as a Refraction Point, the next nearest creature takes damage equal to half the damage the original target took. This effect can only occur up to 4 times per turn.

The original Refraction Point, can never be affected by this chaining effect.

Creatures immune to both Lightning and Cold damage are immune to this condition.
system.summary: Ranged Ranton or Laser Circus damage refracts: the nearest hostile creature within 30 ft takes half, chaining up to 4 times a turn.

rules.text: When it takes damage from a ranged Ranton Hijutsu or Laser Circus attack, the nearest creature within 30 ft hostile to the Ranton takes half that damage, then this ends. A Refraction Point damaged this way passes half on to the next nearest (up to 4 times per turn; never back to the original).
